# Keep package-dependent skips tied to the actual unavailable UI

Bug 1901962 needed a followup for MSIX builds. Current testUpdateHistoryDialog skips Windows when hasWinPackageId because the updates panel is disabled there. A platform alone does not identify that package capability. Keep the source reason next to the skip; no MSIX test run was performed.

Scope: mail/components/preferences.

## Evidence

[Lesson record](../records/e498530aa3526158154b366fc0331efa4178139555dc70875e5f2e02fd16aa25.json).

- [Supporting record](../records/8c03739a707f1a6eca74200f0bb6a601d8218cbd129324cdd6d8bbb67e369150.json)

## Validation and limits

Status: **supported**. Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
